title: Exquisite Gooey Polish Orange Pasta
description: A cultured and gooey lacto-vegetarian Polish dish featuring orange, perfect for a date night, with a cure of citrus and herbs.
instructions: Bring a large pot of salted water to a boil and cook the pappardelle pasta according to the package instructions.
In a large skillet, melt the unsalted butter over medium heat.
Add the orange marmalade to the skillet and stir until it is well combined with the butter.
Pour in the heavy cream and stir until the mixture is smooth and creamy.
Add the grated orange zest, salt, and black pepper to the skillet and stir to combine.
Drain the cooked pasta and add it to the skillet, tossing to coat with the orange cream sauce.
Reduce the heat to low and simmer the pasta for a few minutes, until it is well coated with the sauce.
Stir in the chopped fresh parsley and serve the pasta hot.
Garnish with additional parsley and orange zest if desired.
